name: Phishing
description: Adversaries send phishing messages with malicious attachments or links to gain access.

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Exploiting a weakness in an Internet-facing application (SQL injection, Log4Shell, RCE).

name: Valid Accounts
description: Use of legitimate credentials to gain access, often after brute force or credential theft.

name: External Remote Services
description: Access through VPN, Citrix or other external remote services.

name: PowerShell
description: Abuse of PowerShell, frequently with encoded commands, to execute payloads.

name: Windows Command Shell
description: Abuse of cmd.exe to execute commands.

name: Unix Shell
description: Abuse of Unix shells (bash/sh) to execute commands.

name: User Execution: Malicious File
description: A user opens a malicious file, e.g. an Office document that launches a child process.

name: Windows Management Instrumentation
description: Use of WMI to execute commands locally or remotely.

name: Scheduled Task/Job: Cron
description: Cron jobs used for persistence on Linux/Unix.

name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
description: Windows scheduled tasks used for persistence.

name: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
description: Run keys or startup folder entries that launch malware at logon.

name: Create Account
description: Creation of new accounts to maintain access.

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
description: Exploiting a vulnerability (e.g. PrintNightmare) to gain higher privileges.

name: Account Manipulation
description: Manipulating accounts, e.g. adding a user to a privileged group.

name: Indicator Removal: Clear Windows Event Logs
description: Clearing Windows event logs to hide activity.

name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
description: Disabling antivirus/EDR or security tooling.

name: Obfuscated Files or Information
description: Obfuscation such as base64-encoded commands.

name: Brute Force
description: Repeated authentication attempts to guess passwords.

name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
description: Dumping credentials from LSASS memory, e.g. with Mimikatz.

name: Network Service Discovery
description: Scanning for listening services on remote hosts.

name: Account Discovery
description: Enumerating local or domain accounts.

name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
description: Using RDP to move laterally between hosts.

name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
description: Using admin shares or PsExec over SMB for lateral movement.

name: Exploitation of Remote Services
description: Exploiting remote services such as SMB (EternalBlue).

name: Archive Collected Data
description: Compressing or archiving collected data prior to exfiltration.

name: Data from Local System
description: Collecting sensitive files from local systems.

name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
description: C2 over HTTP/S, e.g. periodic beaconing.

name: Proxy: Multi-hop Proxy
description: Use of Tor or other multi-hop proxies.

name: Application Layer Protocol: DNS
description: C2 or tunnelling over DNS.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Data exfiltrated over the existing C2 channel.

name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
description: Exfiltration to cloud storage services.

name: Data Encrypted for Impact
description: Ransomware encrypting files for impact.

name: Inhibit System Recovery
description: Deleting shadow copies or backups to prevent recovery.

name: Data Destruction
description: Destroying data on systems.
